# `project/SceneManager.js`

> **Source:** `editor/js/project/SceneManager.js`

SceneManager.js - Scene loading, saving, and management Handles: - Scene file I/O (Scenes/*.scene.json) - Scene serialization/deserialization - Multi-scene support - Scene switching

## Functions

### `layerMask(...layers)`

### `hasLayer(mask, layer)`

### `prepareSceneForImport(input)`

Validate and fully normalize a serialized scene before touching live editor state. Missing schemaVersion is the legacy v1 format; future versions fail closed.

### `createSceneData(name = 'Untitled')`

Create empty scene data with full Unity/Godot-style structure

### `serializeScene(editor, sceneName = null)`

Serialize current editor scene to JSON-compatible object

### `async reRegisterCustomMeshes(editor, options = {})`

Re-register custom meshes for imported model entities after scene load. Loads asset data from AssetRegistry, parses geometry, and registers with the renderer.

### `async deserializeScene(editor, sceneData)`

Validate and stage a complete scene before replacing live editor state. If an unexpected runtime failure occurs while applying it, restore the previously serialized scene so callers never inherit a half-loaded scene.

### `clearScene(editor)`

Clear all entities and folders from scene

### `async saveSceneToFile(editor, sceneName = null)`

Save scene to file system

### `async loadSceneFromFile(editor, fileName)`

Load scene from file system

### `async listScenes(editor)`

List all scenes in project

### `async deleteSceneFile(editor, fileName)`

Delete scene file

### `newScene(editor, name = 'Untitled')`

Create new scene (clears current and sets name)

### `findEntitiesByLayer(editor, layer)`

Find all entities on a specific layer

### `findEntitiesByLayerMask(editor, mask)`

Find all entities matching a layer mask

### `findEntitiesByTag(editor, tag)`

Find all entities with a specific tag

### `findEntityByTag(editor, tag)`

Find first entity with a specific tag

### `findEnabledEntities(editor)`

Find all enabled entities (active in scene)

### `findEntitiesByRenderFlags(editor, flags, matchAll = true)`

Find all entities with specific render flags

### `findPrefabInstances(editor, prefabUuid = null)`

Find all prefab instances

### `getEntityConnections(editor, entityId)`

Get all connections for an entity (both incoming and outgoing)

### `addConnection(editor, fromEntity, signal, toEntity, method, flags = 0, binds = [])`

Add a signal connection between entities

### `removeConnection(editor, fromEntity, signal, toEntity, method)`

Remove a signal connection

### `setEntityLayer(editor, entityId, layer)`

Set entity layer

### `setEntityTag(editor, entityId, tag)`

Set entity tag

### `addEntityTag(editor, entityId, tag)`

Add tag to entity's tags array

### `removeEntityTag(editor, entityId, tag)`

Remove tag from entity's tags array

### `setEntityRenderFlags(editor, entityId, flags)`

Set entity render flags

### `setEntityEnabled(editor, entityId, enabled)`

Set entity enabled state

## Notes & Examples

### Editor Extension System

The editor supports extensions via the same Plauna component system as apps. Extensions can add panels, tools, menu items, and hooks into the engine. They run with elevated 'editor' capability granting access to the scene graph, asset database, and build pipeline.

**Example: Editor extension adding a custom panel**
```js
import { Extension } from 'editor/core/Extension.js';
import { Panel } from 'editor/ui/Panel.js';

class TerrainEditor extends Extension {
  id = 'terrain-editor';
  capabilities = ['editor', 'scene'];
  
  activate(context) {
    // Add menu item
    context.menus.add('Tools/Terrain', () => this.open());
    
    // Register tool
    context.tools.register('terrain', {
      icon: 'mountain',
      onSelect: (entity) => this.edit(entity)
    });
  }
  
  open() {
    this.panel = new Panel({
      title: 'Terrain Editor',
      content: this.buildUI()
    });
    context.workspace.addPanel(this.panel);
  }
  
  edit(entity) {
    const terrain = entity.get(TerrainComponent);
    this.panel.bind(terrain);
  }
}

editor.extensions.register(TerrainEditor);
```
